rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for an inference that something is probably true.

example.english: They have presumably got home already.
example.traditional: 佢應該已經返到屋企喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jing1 goi1 ji5 ging1 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize an approximate degree of probability or uncertainty.

example.english: We will presumably only get back at around eight.
example.jyutping: daai6 koi3 baat3 dim2 sin1 faan2 dou3

rows.note: Use this when the speaker presents the presumption explicitly as an estimate, especially before a clause.

example.jyutping: gu2 gai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5
